locations: Street fight in a parking lot
On top of a car hood
reasons: Bumped into each other at a club
Argument over who's the better fighter
Argument over money owed from a bet
outfits: Suit and tie (formal event gone wrong)

clipTypes.label: Establishing location shot
clipTypes.action: Wide shot of the empty location, no fighters in frame yet, setting the scene.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subtle ambient motion in the scene only. No subjects yet.

clipTypes.label: Faceoff / staredown
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B stand face to face, inches apart, locked in a heated staredown. Both confident, both holding their ground. No physical contact yet.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B stare each other down, mouths moving, intense expressions. No punches.

clipTypes.label: Trash talk / yelling
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B face to face, yelling and pointing fingers. Both confident, both holding their ground.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B yell at each other in English, mouths moving aggressively, pointing fingers, both confident. No punches.

clipTypes.label: Subject A approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject A walks toward the location with intensity and confidence. Subject B is not yet in frame.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A walks forward toward the camera with intensity and confidence. Camera locked.

clipTypes.label: Subject B approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject B walks toward the location with intensity and confidence. Subject A is not yet in frame.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B walks forward toward the camera with intensity and confidence. Camera locked.

clipTypes.label: Mid-fight exchange
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B mid-fight, exchanging punches, both fighting hard, both strong.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B throw punches at each other. A few sharp exchanges, both fighting hard.

clipTypes.label: Knockout — Subject A wins
clipTypes.action: The moment Subject A connects a clean punch. Subject B is just starting to fall, caught with a great shot.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B throws one punch. Subject A slips it. Subject A throws one knockout punch. Subject B drops to the ground tough — caught with a great shot. Subject A stands still, calm and confident.

clipTypes.label: Knockout — Subject B wins
clipTypes.action: The moment Subject B connects a clean punch. Subject A is just starting to fall, caught with a great shot.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A throws one punch. Subject B slips it. Subject B throws one knockout punch. Subject A drops to the ground tough — caught with a great shot. Subject B stands still, calm and confident.

clipTypes.label: Victory — Subject A stands tall
clipTypes.action: Subject A stands tall and confident. Subject B is on the ground, tough but knocked out.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A stands tall and confident. Subject B is on the ground, tough but knocked out. Slight motion only.

clipTypes.label: Victory — Subject B stands tall
clipTypes.action: Subject B stands tall and confident. Subject A is on the ground, tough but knocked out.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B stands tall and confident. Subject A is on the ground, tough but knocked out. Slight motion only.
